title: A vendor invoice from a delivery uses the delivery's location calendar
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You are working in {Location-A}; a delivery for vendor {Vendor-A} belongs to {Location-B}, in a time zone where the date is already one day later. Run the case at a time of day when the two dates differ.
    For example: {Location-A} is in Edmonton, {Location-B} is in Auckland and {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-18 Vendor on Net 30.
  • Today's date at {Location-B} is {Date-A}; {Date-B} is {Date-A} plus 30 days.
    For example: {Date-A} is Oct 22, 2026 and {Date-B} is Nov 21, 2026.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Receive the delivery for {Vendor-A}.
  2. Open the new vendor invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the delivery is received and its vendor invoice is created.
  • Step 2: its due date reads {Date-B}, counted from {Location-B}'s date {Date-A} (not from your location's date).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R6a: “The same invoice shows the same due date to every user, whichever location they are working in. A vendor invoice created by receiving a delivery uses the delivery's location, even when the receiving user is working in another location.”
  • S7-R6: “Due dates are counted on the calendar of the location the invoice or vendor invoice belongs to, never the location of the user, API connection or import that creates or views it, so a daylight saving change inside the span never moves the date: an Edmonton invoice dated Oct 5 on "10th of the following month" is due Nov 10 (not Nov 9).”
